segments.he:
א.

עַל־יְדֵי סִפּוּרֵי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים מַמְשִׁיכִין אוֹר שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ בָּעוֹלָם, וְדוֹחֶה הַרְבֵּה חֹשֶׁךְ וְצָרוֹת מִן הָעוֹלָם, גַּם זוֹכֶה לִבְגָדִים נָאִים.
segments.en: One who informs on his fellow man  (to gentiles)  ends up being a vagabond, enemies rise up against him, he experiences himself that which he wanted to bring upon his fellow, all those who depend on him fall, and the family of the one he pursued takes his greatness.

segments.he:
ב.

עַל־יְדֵי תְּשׁוּבָה הָרוּחַ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ מְנַּשֶׁבֶת עַל גְּזֵרוֹת הַמַּלְכֻיּוֹת וּמְבַטְּלָן.
segments.en: One who informs  (to gentiles)  on the  T zaddik  loses all his possessions.

segments.he:
ג.

עָתִיד דּוֹר אֶחָד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בָּעוֹלָם, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה כֻּלּוֹ זַכַּאי.
segments.en: It is permitted to kill an informer  (to gentiles) .
It is forbidden to deliver  (to gentiles)  even an evildoer to execution.

segments.he:
ה.

עַל־יְדֵי שְׁמִירַת שַׁבָּת מַמְשִׁיךְ עַל עַצְמוֹ אוֹר שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ ,  גַּם עַל־יְדֵי תְּשׁוּבָה.

segments.en: Through the stories of  T zaddikim , the light of the  Mashiach  is drawn into the world, much darkness and suffering is dispelled from the world, and also one merits to attractive clothing .
